ARABIC — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency.

2. When practising Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information.

3. When practising Speaking Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Speaking Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Speaking Fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Speaking Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Speaking Fluency.

4. When practising Selective Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening ● Scanning ● Vocabulary Building ● Extracting information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening ● Scanning ● Vocabulary Building ● Extracting information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening ● Scanning ● Vocabulary Building ● Extracting information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening ● Scanning ● Vocabulary Building ● Extracting information.

6. When practising Intensive Reading: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading: Poetry.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading: Poetry.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading: Poetry.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading: Poetry.

7. When practising Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening Comprehension.

8. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.

9. When practising Extensive Reading: Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive Reading: Library skills.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Extensive Reading: Library skills.

10. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist.

11. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Mechanics of Writing: Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Paragraph Writing: Sequencing Ideas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptive Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency.

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information.

3. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Speaking Fluency.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Selective Listening.

5. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening ● Scanning ● Vocabulary Building ● Extracting information.

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading: Poetry.

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening Comprehension.

8. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.

9. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive Reading: Library skills.

10. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.

11. A — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

15. (4 marks)
